correctness.rationale: Solving the equilibrium equations with \(x\ne0\) gives \(z=c/a\), \(xy=bc/a\), and \(x^2=bc^2/a^3\), hence the two isolated equilibria stated. Substitution in the Jacobian gives \(p(\lambda)=\lambda^3+(a+b)\lambda^2+(bc^2/a^2)\lambda+2bc^2/a\). For a cubic with all positive coefficients, the nontrivial Routh determinant is \((bc^2/a^2)(b-a)\): it is positive exactly for \(b>a\), while for \(0<b<a\) the first-column sign sequence has two changes, hence exactly two right-half-plane roots. At \(b=a\) direct multiplication gives \((\lambda+2a)(\lambda^2+c^2/a)\). At \((5,2,34)\) this cubic has no zero root, contradicting the source's printed local spectrum. The bundled verification directory was inspected; its computation is corroborative, while the all-parameter proof is exact Routh algebra.
risks: No Hopf bifurcation is claimed at the nonhyperbolic boundary; nonlinear nondegeneracy was not analyzed.

It lists the same isolated equilibria and, at \((5,2,34)\), prints a spectrum containing a zero eigenvalue, then analyzes the separate equilibrium line. It does not give the exact isolated-equilibrium characteristic polynomial or the parameter-global boundary \(b=a\). Resultary search found the audited record itself and related equilibrium corrections for other flows, but no earlier theorem for this exact system. The correction and sharp classification are therefore original to the best of the inspected evidence.
